# Card AI

> Card AI is a trading card scanner, card price checker, and collection tracker that suggests likely catalog matches from a photo, lets collectors confirm printing details, and tracks available raw and graded market prices over time.

The [canonical website](https://tcgcard.fun/) is tcgcard.fun. Card AI supports collectors across Pokemon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Disney Lorcana, Digimon, Dragon Ball Super, and Naruto, as well as sports cards including basketball, football, and soccer.

## Core Capabilities

- AI-assisted card matching from a photo, with candidate details such as set and card number for review
- User confirmation of the matching card, finish, language, raw condition, or existing slab grade before saving
- Bulk scanning for working through a stack of cards in one session
- Card price checking, price history, and market trends
- Raw and graded card values, tracked separately by condition and by grade (PSA, BGS, CGC, SGC)
- Portfolio organization and collection value tracking over time
- Card database search by name, set, or card number without scanning
- Wishlist management
- Multi-game and sports card collection support

## Pages

- [Basketball card scanner](https://tcgcard.fun/basketball-card-scanner): Scan basketball cards to find matching catalog records, confirm the parallel and finish, then check market values for raw and graded copies.
- [Bulk card scanner](https://tcgcard.fun/bulk-card-scanner): Scan trading cards in bulk instead of one at a time. Work through boxes and binders in a single session and add everything to your collection together.
- [Card collection tracker](https://tcgcard.fun/card-collection-tracker): Track what a trading card collection is worth. Keep condition- and grade-specific holdings, follow price history, and monitor total portfolio value.
- [Card identifier](https://tcgcard.fun/card-identifier): Identify a trading card from a photo. AI card recognition suggests matching catalog records with the set and card number for you to review.
- [Card price checker](https://tcgcard.fun/card-price-checker): Check what a trading card is worth. Scan or search the card catalog to compare current raw and graded prices, price history, and market direction.
- [Digimon card scanner](https://tcgcard.fun/digimon-card-scanner): Scan Digimon Card Game cards to find matching set and card records, confirm the art variant, then check raw and graded market values.
- [Digital card binder](https://tcgcard.fun/digital-card-binder): Build a searchable digital card binder. Organize records by game and language, track quantities, and find raw or graded copies without opening boxes.
- [Dragon Ball Super card scanner](https://tcgcard.fun/dragon-ball-super-card-scanner): Scan Dragon Ball Super Card Game cards to find matching records with set, card number and rarity, then confirm the printing and check its value.
- [Flesh and Blood card scanner](https://tcgcard.fun/flesh-and-blood-card-scanner): Scan Flesh and Blood cards to find matching set and rarity records, confirm the foiling, then check raw and graded market values.
- [Football card scanner](https://tcgcard.fun/football-card-scanner): Scan football cards to find matching set and card records, confirm the parallel or serial numbering, then check raw and graded values.
- [Graded card tracker](https://tcgcard.fun/graded-card-tracker): Track graded and raw cards side by side. Record the grading company and grade, see values by grade, and compare what a card is worth raw versus slabbed.
- [Lorcana card scanner](https://tcgcard.fun/lorcana-card-scanner): Scan Disney Lorcana cards to find matching set and card records, confirm the finish, then check market values and track your collection.
- [MTG card scanner](https://tcgcard.fun/mtg-card-scanner): Scan Magic: The Gathering cards to find matching set and collector-number records, confirm the treatment, and track MTG prices and collection value.
- [One Piece card scanner](https://tcgcard.fun/one-piece-card-scanner): Scan One Piece Card Game cards to find matching set and card records, confirm the art variant, then check raw and graded market values.
- [Pokemon card scanner](https://tcgcard.fun/pokemon-card-scanner): Scan Pokemon cards to find matching set and card records, confirm the printing, then check raw and graded market values and track your collection.
- [Soccer card scanner](https://tcgcard.fun/soccer-card-scanner): Scan soccer cards to find matching set and card records, confirm the parallel or numbering, then check raw and graded market values.
- [Star Wars Unlimited card scanner](https://tcgcard.fun/star-wars-unlimited-card-scanner): Scan Star Wars Unlimited cards to find matching set and card records, confirm the variant, then check market values and track your collection.
- [Yu-Gi-Oh! card scanner](https://tcgcard.fun/yugioh-card-scanner): Scan Yu-Gi-Oh! cards to find matching set-code and rarity records, confirm the edition, then check raw and graded market values.
- [Blog](https://tcgcard.fun/blog/): Guides on card values, grading, and collection tracking.
- [Pokemon TCG 30th Celebration card prices and set guide](https://tcgcard.fun/blog/pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration-card-prices): Check a dated Pokemon TCG 30th Celebration price snapshot, learn the 30C and 30C-CC set codes, and confirm a card in Card AI.
- [What is my trading card worth?](https://tcgcard.fun/blog/what-is-my-trading-card-worth): A practical guide to checking what a trading card is worth, why the same card has several different prices, and which number actually applies to your copy.
- [Raw vs graded cards, and what grading does to value](https://tcgcard.fun/blog/raw-vs-graded-card-values): Why graded cards trade at a premium over raw copies, how the gap between grades works, and when grading a card is worth the cost and the wait.
